card.title: HURRICANE Mk IIA
card.flavorText: The Hurricane Mark IIA was a British fighter aircraft, built in 1940 and used by the Allies throughout WWII. The aircraft was a Hawker Hurricane variant where they first experimented with fitting cannons, first with two 20 mm (.79 in) Oerlikon cannons, one under each wing, and later with four 20 mm (.79 in) Hispano Mk II cannons, two under each wing.
